pr86.title: Star Trek species gold 001: finish Ferengi before advancing
pr86.head: 6c2b52d2efe8137f3f700a7ca5763fe77836cc66
pr86.reason: The branch predates nine current-main commits and became the base for a large divergent stack. Its gold contract remains useful, but merging the branch as-is would make current-main reconciliation implicit and would preserve obsolete stack topology.
retained_claims: Ferengi remains the active unfinished Star Trek maintenance orbit
gold requires exact media rather than absence disposition alone
gold must be proven on merged main and the live deployment
claims_requiring_current_main_adjudicati: the exact set of 32 non-verified Ferengi cards
candidate choices and media hashes gathered on the stale branch
any assertion that later species work is blocked as a repository fact rather than an operating priority

pr87.title: Handoff website maintenance; isolate card backfill lane
pr87.head: df1bd8ddaf76cce82651713114cef5bbcc28a6e3
pr87.reason: PR 87 explicitly required replay onto the resulting current main after PR 86 was resolved. That condition was never satisfied, so the branch is evidence for replay rather than a valid merge target.

declared_replay_commits.purpose: make canonical gate portable on Windows
sitewide truth and bounded website polish
document website maintenance and card-backfill lanes

pr87.replay_rule: Each commit must be compared with current main and replayed by surviving semantic object, not blindly cherry-picked. Already-present or superseded changes receive an explicit no-op or supersession receipt.

required_sequence: inventory current-main Ferengi truth and media state
compare PR 86 claims and candidate bytes against current main
replay surviving PR 87 truth, gate, shell, and ownership objects
import permanent evidence packets without canonical mutation
run bounded canonical adoption as a later transaction

closure_conditions.pr86: Close only after its surviving policy and Ferengi claims have explicit successor receipts on the main-based consolidation branch.
closure_conditions.pr87: Close only after every declared replay commit has a replayed, already-present, superseded, or rejected ruling.
closure_conditions.downstream_stack: Do not claim the root dependency collected until the main-based branch passes the complete gate.
